# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `agent-context.json` before substantive work.

Git is the durable memory bus. GitHub Issues are the task registry. An open draft PR is the concurrency claim.

Before coding:
1. inspect open Issues and open/draft PRs for overlap;
2. run the baseline tests;
3. work from an Issue-scoped branch;
4. open a draft PR before substantive changes.

Do not duplicate an overlapping claimed workstream. Review, red-team, subdivide, or choose another issue.

Never fabricate test results, sources, file paths, APIs, or external state. Model consensus is not evidence. Verify prior agent work before extending it.

Do not change licensing, expose credentials, weaken provenance/truth labels, or take irreversible external actions without explicit authorization.

Repository-specific rules in AGENTS.md are authoritative when stricter.
